`manifest-verbose-oci.json` is actual output captured on 2026-10-23 from Docker 28 `docker manifest inspect --verbose ghcr.io/o-avdieiev/offbox-universal:1`, without pulling layers or running a container. It contains the Linux amd64 OCI image and an unknown-platform attestation. The comparable image identity is `OCIManifest.config.digest`, not the descriptor/index digest. Other manifest cases in unit tests are constructed boundary fixtures.

`container-inspect-containerd-store.json` is a constructed boundary fixture, not captured output. It models a container on a Docker host that uses the containerd image store (the default for new Docker 29 installs), where the container's `Image` is the digest of the pulled image index instead of the image config digest. Offbox resolves that digest with `docker manifest inspect --verbose REPOSITORY@DIGEST` and compares config digests. This has not been verified against a real Docker 29 host.
